description: Spec §7.4: Pickup by an on-foot character (owned by the player) succeeds; in that frame the Crate, Icon and Beacon are hidden, the Lid still shows (it pops off), and one BP_DFFxLootBurst stands at the crate tinted with the crate's colour (GetItemLook). Fix round 1: one frame later the Lid has risen at least 10 cm (the test ticks after the crate); 0.8 s after the pickup (the pop's 0.4 s and a headless frame) the Lid is hidden and so is the actor. Reset shows all four again, the Lid back at its rest transform on the Lid socket.
